name: What should I look for in a contractor for kitchen trip hazard removal?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for kitchen trip hazard removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience in flooring repair and general home safety, positive client testimonials, proper licensing, and insurance. A reputable contractor will offer a clear assessment, transparent pricing, and a detailed plan of action. Ensure they understand local building codes and prioritize durable, safe solutions for your kitchen. Always ask for references and check their portfolio.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience, licensing, insurance, positive testimonials, and clear communication on assessment, pricing, and safety solutions.
